subject: Emotions
title: Sexual Disgust
description: A micro-lesson that makes Sexual Disgust usable.

hook.text: Incest is taboo in every known culture. The disgust is so deep that even thinking about it feels wrong.

buildup.text: The Westermarck effect explains it: children raised together lose sexual attraction automatically.

discovery.text: Israeli kibbutzim proved it. Children raised communally almost never married each other.

twist.text: Sexual disgust also regulates mate choice. We reject partners who signal poor health or genetic risk.

climax.text: Arousal suppresses disgust. During intimacy, the brain turns down revulsion to enable contact.

punchline.text: Love lowers the disgust barrier. That's its job.

quiz.question: What is the Westermarck effect?
options: Loss of attraction between co-raised children
